Kit summary

Marvelous Gift BoxBasic
Deals 100% ATK DMG and 300% ATK Detonation DMG to a single enemy, and inflicts 1 layer of [Scare Box] on the target.
Exploding Magic BoxActive
Summons 5 boxes to attack enemies randomly, prioritizing attacking different targets. Each box deals 100% ATK DMG and 190% ATK Detonation DMG to an enemy, and inflicts 1 layer of [Scare Box] on them. [Scare Box]: When casting Exploding Magic Box each time, for every 1 layer of [Scare Box] owned by an enemy, the DMG taken by the enemy each time equals to 170% of the previous time; each enemy is calculated separately. All [Scare Box] will be removed from all enemies when the skill ends. [Scare Box] can be stacked up to 5 layers.
Whimsical CharmPassiveExclusive Lv.1 · Lv.3
If self has the highest initial ATK among allies, gains immunity to control effects. Compares the target's HP percentage before and after self casts Marvelous Gift Box or deals DMG by casting active skills. If the reduced HP percentage is no higher than 10%, additionally deals 400% ATK DMG once ignoring [DMG Immunity], with 100% Crit Rate and 100% Piercing; besides, 100% of Noel's Mastery is converted to Crit DMG in the duration.
Christmas Wand Lv.1Noel is immune to Turn Meter Reduction effect and all allies are immune to [Countess' Curse]. After an ally proactively launches basic attacks or casts active skills, increases Noel's Turn Meter by 5%. When an enemy increases an ally's skill CD, Noel refreshes the CD of all allies' skills and acts for 1 extra turn; this effect can only be triggered once before Noel acts next turn.
Christmas Wand Lv.3After an ally deals DMG by proactively launching basic attacks or casting active skills, if the target has 40% or more HP, Noel additionally deals Direct DMG equal to Whimsical Charm once. After Christmas Magic ends, inflicts 1 layer of [Scare Box] on all enemies. At the beginning of each wave, reduces Turn Meter Increase effect by 100% for the enemy (excluding Boss) who has the highest initial SPD. At the beginning of each wave, grants all allies [Surprise Present] for 2 turns.
Christmas MagicActiveExclusive Lv.2 · Lv.3
Grants all allies [Resolute II] for 2 turns and removes all buffs from all enemies; meanwhile, deals 100% ATK DMG and 570% ATK Detonation DMG to all enemies. Afterward, grants [Surprise Present] (immune to DoT) to all allies for 2 turns.
Christmas Wand Lv.2For every 8 basic attacks launched or active skills cast proactively by allies, Noel will use Christmas Magic to pursue and attack once and gain [Warmth] (increases ATK by 4%), up to 10 layers. When [Warmth] is stacked to max layers, increases all Turn Meter Increase effects on Noel by 100%. After allies take Basic Attack DMG or Active Skill DMG once in any turn, Noel gains [Illusion]: Immune to Basic Attack DMG or Active Skill DMG taken next time before the current turn ends. When any ally takes Basic Attack DMG or Active Skill DMG 4 times in total in any turn, Noel gains 10 layers of [Warmth] immediately.
Christmas Wand Lv.3After an ally deals DMG by proactively launching basic attacks or casting active skills, if the target has 40% or more HP, Noel additionally deals Direct DMG equal to Whimsical Charm once. After Christmas Magic ends, inflicts 1 layer of [Scare Box] on all enemies. At the beginning of each wave, reduces Turn Meter Increase effect by 100% for the enemy (excluding Boss) who has the highest initial SPD. At the beginning of each wave, grants all allies [Surprise Present] for 2 turns.
